remarks: Exceptional investment opportunity in a highly desirable Norwalk location! This 6-unit property features a diverse unit mix: one 3-bedroom, one 2-bedroom, and four 1-bedroom units, appealing to a broad tenant base. The 3-bedroom unit includes an in-unit washer and dryer, adding convenience and rental appeal.  With below-market rents, this asset presents significant value-add potential through strategic rent increases and property enhancements. Located near major highways, public transportation, shopping, and dining, it has strong tenant demand and long-term appreciation. A prime opportunity for investors looking to maximize cash flow and equity growth.
